subject: DT addRow Uses Duplicate Row Names

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: DT addRow Uses Duplicate Row Names
parts: If the row names are numeric, R's rbind function automatically creates names so that the names are unique and consecutive. In the addRow example, the new entries get a row name that is already in use. Does the row name of the one-row data frame need to be manually set by the programmer or may it be automatically handled by DT ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT addRow Uses Duplicate Row Names
parts:
Row names is only a concept in R. DataTables does not have this
concept, and "row names" are only a column in the table, so it does
not matter if there are any duplicates. In the addRow example, the new
row is a random row in the existing data, so the row name will be
duplicated. In your own application, you are free to use new row
names.

Regards,
Yihui
